title: Shakshuka with Cannellini Beans
description: A twist on the classic North African dish, adding cannellini beans for extra protein and fiber.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the shakshuka sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the cannellini beans.
Create 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook, undisturbed, until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness, about 10-12 minutes.
Season the shakshuka with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the shakshuka hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
